title: Tourism source series, qualified reporting and target receiving

task.name: Receive and operate complete tourism source and reporting editions
task.purpose: Give a destination, research partner and receiving engineer a complete editable route from original public or licensed series through explicit dimensions, qualified analyses and frozen reports to a real target CSV and original return.
task.request: Receive the full original working JSON, source-owned installed application and original commercial Workshare. Preserve all physical source files and exact observations, typed values, geography/period/method/unit/price/population distinctions, mappings, attributed corrections, analysis qualifications, report snapshots and original target template/rows/returns. Explicitly select every source, registry, mapping, correction, analysis, report and target edition for the agreed work, with a purpose or exclusion reason. Retain the whole source regardless of selected customer scope. Open the complete offline application through Runtime Files or its saved HTML; use the original controls for new imports, mappings, corrections, calculations, immutable reports and actual target receiving. Prepare and save the existing Customer Installation through the original Operations case and full commercial seed. Independently receive both the complete working application and saved original case. Operate desktop/narrow views, all meaningful states and controls, full exports and exact reopened working files.
task.completeOutput: One complete source-qualified tourism workspace, original files/registry/mapping/correction/report/target history, raw unfinished forms, readable source-selection report, full editable HTML/JSON/ZIP/source, original commercial Installation and independently reopened original case.
task.repeatTrigger: An actual new source edition, agreed later period, explicitly changed method or geographic scope, authorised target template or following original target return creates new useful work. Reopening, a different report format and recovery continue their original source operation.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed complete source onboarding, report cycle or target receiving task. Preserve actual professional scope/fees/effort in the original Workshare and actual merchant-priced units/atomic task budget in the Installation.

source.reference: The exact whole original Tourism working JSON and its workspace genesis/revision/history; every explicitly selected original source, registry, report and target edition; original commercial Workshare and source authority.
source.population: Every original physical file and CSV series, all registry editions, mapped observation rows, correction history, saved analyses, frozen reports, actual target plans and observed returns. The whole record remains retained when a customer scope excludes an edition.
source.meaning: Geography ancestry/overlap, exact periods, metric/unit/multiplier, method/population/price basis and published rounding remain separate. A website user is not a visitor, a county and its district are not additive, an unconfirmed method difference is not a trend. Original source URLs and locators remain provenance; authored transcriptions are identified as transcriptions. Actual target headers/keys come only from a retained real template.
source.changePolicy: New input, mapping or correction creates a new native operation; saved reports preserve their exact earlier inputs and target exports retain original template/rows. Native replay uses its exact request. Browser reopen preserves newer saved copies and both conflicting branches. Record changed commercial scope in its original Installation.

receiving.application: Original offline Tourism Series Workspace and CLI, opened as complete working HTML through Runtime Files or its saved local file, alongside the existing Grant Operations Customer Installation and full Workshare. No separate Tourism server is required.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Attach the byte-complete original working JSON and whole scope selection to the matching Operations case and obtain a fresh Workshare seed. Prepare through the source-owned profile, preserve original phase/funding/effort fields, preview and save the actual Installation. Independently receive the complete working application and original case, reopen all original source/report/target history and preserve any later recipient operations and unfinished forms.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The source owners retain rights and published attribution; the partner controls its original platform, access/licensing and actual destination import. Local selection or filtering does not enforce vendor permissions. A native target return is an observed file, not permission to write an external account. Withdraw or revise a scope through the original customer case and full source history.
receiving.recovery: Keep original complete working JSON, profile, selection, case/seed/bindings, source closure, saved Installation IDs and both receiving directories. Reuse the same retained native request after response loss. Missing staging is recoverable from full retained preparation; a still-present differing original is a source conflict. Later valid recipient operations stay in Current_Working_Recovery.json and their original browser copy.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source analyst, prime/relationship owner, engineer and independent receiving operator. Deliver the entire maintained source/CLI/app/guides and editable originals. Keep actual customer records private in existing custody. Personally open/look/use exact outgoing product and all attachments. Every warm external message and exact attachments require Bryce’s current per-message green.

steps.title: Receive original commercial work
steps.result: Select the complete original Workshare and matching Operations case, planned phases, effort, source rights and funded delivery.

steps.title: Install the complete source
steps.result: Build the tourism-series source selection and use its original CLI, complete working HTML and installed Grant Operations. Keep every source dependency.

steps.title: Retain the full working edition
steps.result: Export complete working JSON including raw unfinished forms and browser selection. Attach its exact bytes to the original case and inspect every retained edition.

steps.title: Select whole customer scope
steps.result: Give every source, registry, mapping, correction, analysis, report and target edition an explicit inclusion/exclusion reason. Attach this full selection and refresh the same-version case and seed.

steps.title: Prepare and save Customer Installation
steps.result: Populate real host/operator/deployment/payment/source authority bindings. Preserve whole commercial checks and original outcomes; preview and save through the existing writer.

steps.title: Operate qualified source work
steps.result: Use original column mappings, exact decimal values, explicit dimensions and authorised registry rules. Preserve residuals, rejected overlaps and unconfirmed method differences in complete reports.

steps.title: Receive an actual target result
steps.result: Load a real original template; explicitly map its columns and key rows. Retain prepared export, actual returned original and complete matched/missing/unexpected/conflicting results.

steps.title: Receive both whole workspaces
steps.result: Use the full native continuation to retain all prepared files, open an independent Tourism copy, export/verify/import the exact saved Installation and reopen all selected originals.

steps.title: Continue later work
steps.result: Save a useful new receiving-side change through the actual app, download its full recovery under the original independent copy, then continue the original receive and observe the later history surviving.

steps.title: Inspect complete outgoing product
steps.result: Personally open/look/use exact desktop and narrow apps, full readable reports and all attachments; open usable ZIP contents and every applicable PDF page, download/reopen working files and repair concrete defects.

inputs: Full original commercial Workshare commissioning source and complete packet; current Operations case and pinned plan.
Complete original Tourism workspace or recovery JSON, including every original binary/text file, source/registry/mapping/correction/analysis/report/target edition and operation.
Explicit full edition scope with original kind/index/ID/content binding and actual inclusion/exclusion purpose.
Actual source licences and permissions, published locator/transcription distinctions, original metric/geography/time/method/unit semantics.
When applicable, actual native target CSV template, explicit field/key mapping and full observed returned file.
Fresh complete case and matching Workshare seed after both full source attachments; original source IDs and actual selected commercial bindings.
Installed Node22.16+ and existing Grant Operations Python3.11+ runtime; original and independent receiving directories and named actor.
Original case attachment allowances remain8MiB each,24MiB aggregate and200 files. Keep larger complete workspaces in original custody; no summary substitution.
Actual source report, complete source ZIP, saved Installation and personally viewed/rendered desktop/narrow/control/all-attachment results.
